final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT product_id AS pid, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM Order_Items GROUP BY product_id), s2 AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total FROM s1), s3 AS (SELECT s1.pid AS pid, s1.cnt AS cnt, (s1.cnt * 1.0) / s2.total AS ratio FROM s1 JOIN s2 ON s2.total IS NOT NULL AND s2.total <> 0), s4 AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM s3), s5 AS (SELECT s3.pid AS pid, s3.cnt AS cnt, s3.ratio AS ratio, s3.ratio - s4.avg_ratio AS diff FROM s3 JOIN s4 ON s4.avg_ratio IS NOT NULL WHERE s3.ratio > s4.avg_ratio) SELECT SUM(cnt), AVG(ratio), AVG(diff) FROM s5
